paite: Huan ni sawtkuamtak nung in hichi ahong hi a, akum thum kum in TOUPA thu Elijah kiang ah ahong tung hi. "Va kuan inla, Ahab kiang ah va kihil in. Huchi in leitung ah vuah ka zusak ding," achi hi.
heading: Elijah Leh Baal Siampute
english: After many days, Yahweh’s word came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, “Go, show yourself to Ahab; and I will send rain on the earth.”

paite: Ahab kiang a kihil ding in Elijah akuanta hi. Samaria gam ah kial ana mahmah hi.
english: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.

paite: Ahab in Obadiah, a-inn sunglam heutu asam hi. Obadiah bel TOUPA laudan siam mahmah mi ahi a;
english: Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared Yahweh greatly;

paite: huan, hichi ahong hi a, Jezebel in TOUPA zawlneite asatkhiak lai in Obadiah in zawlnei zakhat api a, kokhuk ah sawmnga nga in asel a, tanghou leh tui in avak hi.
english: for when Jezebel cut off Yahweh’s prophets, Obadiah took one hundred prophets, and hid them fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

paite: Ahab in Obadiah kiang ah, "Tui nak nei tengteng leh lui phaizang tengteng omna gam va tuan vialvial dih ve. Sakol leh sabiltungte i hut hing theihna ding in loupa i muhsak thei kha hiam, huchi lou in zaw gante i tan vek kha ding,” achi hi.
english: Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the springs of water, and to all the brooks. Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive, that we not lose all the animals.”

paite: Huchi in gam totsuak ding in akihawm ua; Ahab amah kia in lampi dang ah apai a, Obadiah leng amah kia in lampi dang ah apai hi.
english: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

paite: Huchi a Obadiah apai lai in, ngai in, Elijah in ana tuak a; ama'n athei lai a, huchi in abokkhup a, "Ka toupa Elijah na hi maw?" achi hi.
english: As Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him. He recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "Hi e, kuan inla, ngai in, Elijah huai ah a-om hi, chi in na toupa va hilh in,” achi hi.
english: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here!’”

paite: Ama'n, "Thil bang ahia ka hihkhelh a, na sikha thah dia Ahab khut a na hon piak ding?
english: He said, “How have I sinned, that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?

paite: TOUPA na Pathian ahin bang in ka gen ahi, ka pu in nang ahon zonsaklouhna nam leh gam himhim a-om kei. Hiai ah a-om kei, achih chiang un nang ahon muhlouhna thu uah gam leh nam akichiamsak hi.
english: As Yahweh your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. When they said, ‘He is not here,’ he took an oath of the kingdom and nation that they didn’t find you.

paite: Tu in nang, kuan inla, ngai in, Elijah hiai ah a-om, chi in na toupa va hilh in, na chi hi.
english: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here.”’

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, nang ka hon nutsiattak in TOUPA Kha in ka theihlouhna ah nang ahong lamang dia; huchi in Ahab ka va hilh a, nang ahon muh theih ngal ke'n zaw, kei hon that mai ding hi. Himahleh na sikha in ka valnou tung a pan TOUPA ka lau hi.
english: It will happen, as soon as I leave you, that Yahweh’s Spirit will carry you I don’t know where; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he can’t find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared Yahweh from my youth.

paite: Jezebel in TOUPA zawlneite athah lai a ka thilhih, TOUPA zawlneite lak a mi zakhat, sawmnga nga a kokhuk a, tanghou leh tui a ka vakdan ka toupa hon hilh lou uhia?
english: Wasn’t it told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed Yahweh’s prophets, how I hid one hundred men of Yahweh’s prophets with fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

paite: Tu in nang, kuan inla, ngai in, Elijah huai ah a-om hi, chi in na toupa va hilh in na chi mawk a; ama'n kei ahon that mahmah ding," achi hi.
english: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”

paite: Elijah in, "Ama ka dinna sepaihte' TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, tuni in akiang ah ka kihil ngeingei ding," achi hi.
english: Elijah said, “As Yahweh of Armies lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him today.”

paite: Huchi in Ahab houpih ding in Obadiah akuan a, ahilhta a; huchi in Elijah mu ding in Ahab akuanta hi.
english: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ahab in Elijah amuh in Ahab in akiang ah, "Nang na hi maw, Israelte buaisakpa?" achi hi.
english: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "Israelte ka buaisak kei. Nang leh na pa inkote ahi ve abuaisak zaw; TOUPA thupiakte lehngatsan a, Baal na zuih zawkna ah.
english: He answered, “I have not troubled Israel, but you and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken Yahweh’s commandments and you have followed the Baals.

paite: Huchi in tu in Israel tengteng leh Baal zawlnei zali-le-sawmnga leh Asherah zawlnei, Jezebel dohkan a ankuang um zalite ka kiang ah Karmel tang ah va samkhawm in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel to Mount Carmel, and four hundred fifty of the prophets of Baal, and four hundred of the prophets of the Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”

paite: Huchi in Ahab in Israel suan tengteng kiang ah mi asawl a, zawlneite Karmel tang ah asamkhawm hi.
english: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.

paite: Elijah in mipi tengteng ava naih a, "Vanglak a bang tan om ding na hi ua? TOUPA Pathian ahihleh, amah zui unla; Baal ahihleh amah zui un," achi hi. Mipite'n kam khat in leng adawng kei uh.
english: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If Yahweh is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” The people didn’t say a word.

paite: Huchi in Elijah in mipite kiang ah, "TOUPA zawlnei omsun kei kia ka hi a; Baal zawlneite bel mi zali-le-sawmnga ahi uh.
english: Then Elijah said to the people, “I, even I only, am left as a prophet of Yahweh; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred fifty men.

paite: Huchi in bawngtal nih hong pia uhenla; amau bawngtal khat amau a tuam ding in tel uhenla, semnen uhenla, sing tung ah koih uhenla, anuai ah mei toh kei uhen. Ke'n leng bawngtal khat ka bawl sam dia, sing tung ah ka koih dia mei ahihleh ka toh kei ding.
english: Let them therefore give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under; and I will dress the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under it.

paite: Nou na pathiante min uh sam unla, ke'n TOUPA min ka sam ding. Huchi in mei a hon dawng Pathian pen Pathian hi hen," achi hi. Huchi in mi tengteng in, "Athugen ahoih hi,” chi in adawng uhi.
english: You call on the name of your god, and I will call on Yahweh’s name. The God who answers by fire, let him be God.” All the people answered, “What you say is good.”

paite: Elijah in Baal zawlneite kiang ah, "Nou bawngtal khat nou a tuam ding in tel unla, bawl masa un; nou na tam deuh ua; na pathiante min sam unla, himahleh anuai ah mei toh kei un," achi hi.
english: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull for yourselves, and dress it first, for you are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under it.”

paite: Bawngtal atan pen uh ala ua, abawl ua, "Baal aw, hon dawng in," chi in zingsang a pan sun tan in Baal min asam uh. Himahleh aw himhim a-om kei a, adawng leng a om sam kei a, maitam kibawl tung ah atawm uhi.
english: They took the bull which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, “Baal, hear us!” But there was no voice, and nobody answered. They leaped about the altar which was made.

paite: Sun lai in hichi ahong hi a, "Elijah in amau enghou in, kikou ngaih ve ua; pathian khat ahi ngal a. Midang houpih hiam, nungdelh nei lel hiam, khualzin ahihkeileh ihmu lel phawn teitei ngai houh hi in teh,” achi hi.
english: At noon, Elijah mocked them, and said, “Cry aloud, for he is a god. Either he is deep in thought, or he has gone somewhere, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he sleeps and must be awakened.”

paite: Huchi in angaih a ngaih in akikou ua, ahih zeldan bang un sisan pawt khop hial in temta in aki-atkeh ua, thilzum in akisun uhi.
english: They cried aloud, and cut themselves in their way with knives and lances until the blood gushed out on them.

paite: Sun nung ahong hih in hichi ahong hi a, nitaklam kithoih hun tan in thu agen uhi. Himahleh aw hiam, dawngtu hiam limsaktu leng a-om kei.
english: When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and nobody paid attention.

paite: Huchi in Elijah in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Hong naih dih ua," achi hi. Huchi in mipi tengteng in ava naih uhi.
english: Elijah said to all the people, “Come near to me!”; and all the people came near to him. He repaired Yahweh’s altar that had been thrown down.

paite: TOUPA maitam kichimsa abawlhoih a; na min Israel ahi ding, chi a TOUPA thu ana mupa Jakob tapate nam zah suang sawm-le-nih Elijah in ala hi.
english: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom Yahweh’s word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”

paite: Huai suangte in TOUPA min in maitam abawl a; maitam kim buhchi tehna nih takna ding atoukuak hi.
english: With the stones he built an altar in Yahweh’s name. He made a trench around the altar large enough to contain two seahs of seed.

paite: Sing akoih hoih sipsip a, bawngtal asemnen a, sing tung ah akoih hi. "Bel li tui in dimsak unla, halmang thillat leh sing buak un," achi hi.
english: He put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. He said, “Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood.”

paite: Anihveina ding in, "Buak nawn un," achi a, abuak nawn uhi. Athumveina ding in, "Buak nawn un," achi a, abuak nawn uhi.
english: He said, “Do it a second time;” and they did it the second time. He said, “Do it a third time;” and they did it the third time.

paite: Huchi in tui maitam kim ah aluang zuazua a; tohkuak tui in adimta hi.
english: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.

paite: Nitaklam kithoih hun in hichi ahong hi a, zawlnei Elijah in ava naih a, "TOUPA Abraham, Isak leh Israel Pathian, nang Israel gam a Pathian na hihleh, kei na sikha ka hih, hiai tengteng nang thu a ka hih tuni in theihsak hi hen.
english: At the time of the evening offering, Elijah the prophet came near and said, “Yahweh, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.

paite: Hon ngaikhia in, aw TOUPA hon ngaikhia in, hiai mipite'n nang TOUPA Pathian na hi a, alungtang uh na heikik nawnta chih atheihna ding un," achi hi.
english: Hear me, Yahweh, hear me, that this people may know that you, Yahweh, are God, and that you have turned their heart back again.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA mei ahong kia a, halmang thillat, asing, asuang leh aleivui akangtum a, tohkuak a tui ahipkang hi.
english: Then Yahweh’s fire fell and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust; and it licked up the water that was in the trench.

paite: Huchi in mipi tengteng in huai amuh un abokkhup ua, "TOUPA amah Pathian ahi, TOUPA amah Pathian ahi,” achi uh.
english: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces. They said, “Yahweh, he is God! Yahweh, he is God!”

paite: Elijah in akiang uah, "Baal zawlneite man unla, khat leng suaktasak kei un," achi hi. Huchi in aman ua, Elijah in Kishon lui ah apisuk a, huai ah amaute athat hi.
english: Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and killed them there.

paite: Elijah in Ahab kiang ah, "Paitou inla, ne in dawnta in; vuahpi zu ding husa a-om," achi hi.
heading: Khokheng Beina
english: Elijah said to Ahab, “Get up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain.”

paite: Ne leh dawn ding in Ahab apaitouta hi. Elijah bel Karmel tang vum ah apaitou a; lei ah akunsuk a, akhukte kikal ah amai aphual hi.
english: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.

paite: Asikha kiang ah, "Va paitou inla, tuipi lam va en mah dih!" achi hi. Ava paitou a, tuipi lam a-en a, "Bangmah a-om kei," achi hi. Ama'n, "Sagihvei kuan nawn in,” achi hi.
english: He said to his servant, “Go up now and look toward the sea.” He went up and looked, then said, “There is nothing.” He said, “Go again” seven times.

paite: Asagihveina ah hichi ahong hi a, "Ngai in, tuipi a pan mihing khuttum chia lel meipi hong lengtou viaiviai," achi hi. Ama'n, "Va pai inla, Ahab kiang ah, na kangtalai bawl inla, paisukta in, vuah in ahon khum kha ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: On the seventh time, he said, “Behold, a small cloud, like a man’s hand, is rising out of the sea.” He said, “Go up, tell Ahab, ‘Get ready and go down, so that the rain doesn’t stop you.’”

paite: Sawt lou nung in hichi ahong hi a, huih leh meipite in van adup keihkuih a, vuahpi tam petmah ahong zuta hi. Ahab kangtalai a tuang in Jezreel ah apaita hi.
english: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

paite: TOUPA khut Elijah tung ah a-om a; apuan ateng a, Ahab ma ah Jezreel kholutna tan atai hi.
english: Yahweh’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
